resources.name: Initial guess coordinates for DFT optimization

access.notes: Provided in the task container at /app/inputs/initial_guesses.xyz, containing three initial guess structures (IGA, IGB, IGC) extracted from the paper's Supporting Information.
Open-source quantum chemistry package; can be used to perform BP86 and B3LYP DFT calculations.
Python-based DFT code; can be installed via pip and used as an alternative to ORCA.
Basis sets (def2-TZVP, def2-SVP) are automatically retrieved by quantum chemistry packages.
